mechanism: Pyrazinamide may increase uric acid levels and affect calcium-phosphate metabolism, while cholecalciferol enhances intestinal calcium absorption, potentially leading to hypercalcemia and hyperuricemia in susceptible patients.
action: Monitor serum calcium and uric acid levels during concurrent use; assess for symptoms of hypercalcemia; consider baseline and periodic monitoring in patients with renal impairment or hyperparathyroidism.
